# Set Name

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Sets the name of an item.

## Syntax

~~~~text
setName(input: <#Variable (Optional)#>, name: <#String (Allows Variables)#>, dontIncludeExtension: <#Boolean (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
setName(input: Clipboard, name: "ClipboardCopy", dontIncludeExtension: false)
~~~~
